title: Mounts
text: In ArcheAge Classic there are plenty of different mounts to collect. Most of them can be obtained by playing the game: obtained from point shops, from npcs or various events and custom questlines. Some mounts can be bought from Marketplace, but those are nerfed versions, meaning they have less skills than other mounts or same or less speed that other mounts have to eliminate the possibility on using real money to gain advantage. Since there are so many mounts it is easier to categorize them by how to obtain them so the pages are easier to read and not clutter with endless list. Some mounts can be obtained various ways. Starter Mounts Taming Mounts Cash Shop Mounts Event Mounts Special Mounts Priceless Coin Mounts World Boss Mounts Point Shop Mounts Gift Mounts
